reuse.why: Builds every step on the tree's existing isWrittenByMonthAction, getCategoriesWithGroupHidden and toAverageBudgetAmount, and recognises #fixed with the shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Rules are added once in the predicate; the only repetition is the has_template/group_note columns and notes join added to both getBudgetData and getCategoriesWithGroupHidden, plus the repeated multi-line predicate call per action.

placement.why: Template, #fixed and hidden-on-request rules all land in the predicate documented as the single definition, and the new action is registered in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: Only month-wide actions, their shared predicate/queries, the new method, tests and handler registration change.

maintainability.why: One predicate with an explicit action discriminator and a single flag is easy to own; small wrinkles are the reshaped average branch now expressed as group_hidden !== null and the new last-month action reusing the 'average' scope and average-named sign helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth, setZero, the 3/6/12-month averages and setLastMonthSpending all call isWrittenByMonthAction.

disguised_duplication.where: The only overlap (selected columns in two queries) is overt.

abstraction_drift.where: isWrittenByMonthAction gains includeHiddenCategories; template and #fixed checks are folded into one shared exclusion condition and the per-action hidden branches were merged rather than multiplied; no caller bypasses it.
